Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The 17 Assistant Professor posts are spread over 10 subjects as follows. The notice gives the reservation for all 17 posts together, not subject by subject. Of the 17 posts, 01 is reserved for a Person with Disability (4%, Group A) and 00 for Orphans (1%). Reservation of VJNT categories is internally transferable as per Government Resolution. PWD, Woman, Orphans and Sports Person reservation will be applicable as per Government Resolution and circulars issued from time to time. Reservation is as per the Maharashtra Educational Institutions (Reservation In Teacher's Cadre) Act, 2021 notification dated 07-04-2022 and the Government Resolution of the Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra, dated 11-04-2022.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: A relaxation of 5% will be provided, from 55% to 50% of the marks at the Master's degree level, for the SC/ST category. The notice does not mention any experience requirement or age limit. Candidates should check the official notification and the rules it refers to for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: As prescribed by the Apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the Apex body, the Government of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The notice does not print a pay amount or pay level. The vacant posts and all terms and conditions are as mentioned in No Objection letter No. JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00007 dated 17.09.2026 from the Hon. Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai. All terms and conditions mentioned in the GR dated 12.11.2021 from the Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra, apply. The recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Hon. Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015. The recruitment process will be carried out subject to the final outcome of cases pending in various courts regarding social and parallel reservations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for YCM Islampur Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printed copy of the online application form All requisite documents Caste Validity Certificate – reserved category candidates, as per the directions of the State Government in Circular No. BCC-2011/Pra. Kra 1064/2011/16-B, dated 12-12-2011 Non-Creamy Layer certificate – reserved category candidates except SC/ST, to be produced at the time of interview

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Professor vacancies are there in YCM Islampur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 17 Assistant Professor posts across 10 subjects, with the highest number in Commerce (03) and Economics (03).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the YCM Islampur Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be made within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement dated 5 November 2026, which works out to about 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the YCM Islampur Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The qualification is as prescribed by the Apex body, the Government of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur, with marks at the Master's degree level relaxed from 55% to 50% for the SC/ST category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a YCM Islampur Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The pay scale is as prescribed by the Apex body, the Government of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time; no amount is printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for YCM Islampur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the online application form on https://ycmislampur.ac.in and send a printed copy with all requisite documents to the Honarary General Secretary, Walwa Taluka Education Society, Islampur, Tal.- Walwa, Dist.- Sangli, within 15 days of publication.

faq.question: Q6. How many posts are reserved for women and persons with disability?
faq.answer: Four posts are reserved for women (02 OBC and 02 OPEN) and one post is reserved for a Person with Disability (Group A).

faq.question: Q7. Will reserved category candidates from other states get reservation?
faq.answer: No. Reserved category candidates from outside the State of Maharashtra will be treated as Open Category.

faq.question: Q8. Do reserved category candidates need to send a copy of the application elsewhere?
faq.answer: Yes, reserved category candidates are advised to send a copy of their application to the Deputy Registrar, Special Cell, Shivaji University, Kolhapur- 416004 (Room No. 138).

faq.question: Q9. Which certificates must reserved category candidates produce?
faq.answer: Reserved category candidates must produce the Caste Validity Certificate, and those other than SC/ST must also produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate at the time of interview.
